summary: Verified the fix for Sound Clinic /api/referrals/dashboard 500 (KeyError: 'diagnostics_payout') by removing the early-return short-circuit in _dashboard_rows. All 10 existing referral pytest cases pass. Added a new backend regression suite (test_referrals_dashboard_bugfix.py) covering: (a) Sound Clinic dashboard returns 200 with all 11 required keys per row and all zeros; (b) Sound Clinic /api/referrals/pathways still 200; (c) dltest regression tenant still returns non-zero payouts with full row schema. Playwright drove /login -> /referrals as owner@thesoundclinic.in — the red 'Internal server error' banner is gone, the Referral Corner heading, KPI cards and 5 doctor rows all render with ₹0, and no /api/referrals XHR 500s observed.

minor.issue: Returns 500 on Sound Clinic tenant (observed as side-effect XHR while on /referrals page). Not related to this fix but worth investigating separately.
Returns 500 on Sound Clinic tenant. Same pattern — likely a similar unguarded aggregation on empty data. Not blocking referrals fix.

Sound Clinic /referrals renders 5 referring-doctor rows with all zeros as expected (Dr AK, Dr. Aarav Mehta, Dr. Anand Kumar, Dr. Prakash Iyer, Dr. Suma Rao). Note: /api/ha/fittings has a separate but similar 500 on the same tenant — worth flagging as a possible follow-up.
rca of the issue: In routers/referrals.py _dashboard_rows, an early-return `if not patient_to_doctor: return list(doctors.values())` skipped the finalize loop that adds diagnostics_payout/ha_payout/total_payout/total_revenue/diag_patient_count/ha_patient_count keys onto each doctor dict. Downstream totals aggregation then hit KeyError. Fix removes the short-circuit — the aggregation queries below already no-op on empty patient_to_doctor (Mongo $in: []), so the finalize loop runs and every row ships with the full schema. Verified via pytest + curl + Playwright.
